title: PhenoPhaseR: Reproducible processing workflow for interpolating phenological DWD observations
description:
PhenoPhaseR is a reproducible R workflow for downloading, filtering, modelling, and spatially interpolating phenological observations provided by the German Weather Service (DWD). It implements the PHASE approach (Gerstmann et al. 2016), combining growing-degree-day models with geostatistical interpolation to produce area-wide phenological predictions across Germany at 1 km spatial resolution.

v1.8.0 — honest anchoring of spatially explicit uncertainty. A metadata/vocabulary release with no numerical changes to any raster or to the VAM/CAL/GEM/PIC tables. The spatial-uncertainty quality dimensions are migrated from the dffp: namespace to a provisional fairagrodq: namespace (https://w3id.org/fairagro/dq#, pending registration) and now declare dct:isDefinedBy Säurich et al. (2026) rather than asserting conformance to ISO 19157-1, which does not contain a Spatial-Uncertainty element. A new orthogonal expression-principle axis (fairagrodq:UncertaintyExpressionPrinciple, a SKOS scheme of eight principle concepts reached via fairagrodq:expressedBy) records how each uncertainty was produced and what it may claim, so a consumer can distinguish model-asserted from empirically-validated uncertainty. Genuine ISO 19157-1 accuracy elements remain the anchor for accuracy metrics; dffp: is retained solely for the Application-Matrix fitness-for-purpose review. Already-published crates keep their original IRIs as historical record.
